meta.title: Implement conditional Cocoa linking for targets
meta.body_summary: Move Sentry Cocoa framework linking configuration to execute only when Apple targets are present in the Gradle task graph, improving build robustness and efficiency for mixed-platform projects.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor deferred Cocoa linking to taskGraph.whenReady; romtsn requested try-catch and config cache validation; after fix and manual test, merged with integration test coverage.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 769 changed lines across 8 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, concentrated in a single Gradle plugin file and an integration test. It fits a moderate incremental build‑time performance improvement that merged after iterative review and manual validation.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer romtsn questioned whether taskGraph.whenReady works correctly with Gradle configuration cache and requested a try-catch around graph.hasTask(path) for robustness. Author confirmed caching works (screenshot) and added the try-catch.
review_details.performance_claim: Defers Cocoa framework linking to only when Apple compile tasks are present in the task graph, avoiding unnecessary path-resolution and linking for non‑Apple builds.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Gradle plugin build system intricacies (task graph, configuration cache) tested Cursor’s understanding of build lifecycle; PR succeeded after author addressed configuration cache and error‑handling concerns.

detection_detail.code_reading: romtsn reviewed the code and raised concerns about configuration cache and error handling; author provided screenshot and explanation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Integration test verifies correct linking behavior but no performance benchmarks are provided; manual testing with config cache shown in screenshot.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Added try-catch around graph.hasTask(path) after review comment.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored SentryPlugin.kt to register a taskGraph.whenReady listener that checks for Apple compile tasks before linking Cocoa framework; added fallback error handling with try-catch and an integration test (CocoaFrameworkLinkerIntegrationTest).
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Integration test and Gradle dependency updates; two earlier unit test files were added then removed during iteration.
